name: Notification Engine
summary: Transactional email, SMS, and push behind provider adapters, with templates, per-user preferences, quiet hours, and digests.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_PROVIDER
env.description: Adapter to use: resend, ses, or none.

env.name: NOTIFY_SMS_PROVIDER
env.description: Adapter to use: twilio, sns, or none.

env.name: NOTIFY_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES
env.description: Window in which an identical dedupe key is suppressed.

env.name: NOTIFY_QUIET_HOURS_DEFAULT
env.description: Default quiet window as HH:MM-HH:MM in the user's timezone. Empty disables.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Send due notifications, including those deferred past quiet hours.

operations.title: POST /notify
operations.description: Enqueue a notification, applying preferences and quiet hours.

operations.title: POST /send
operations.description: Cron. Send due and released notifications.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
